profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, with the ticker AI and SEC CIK 0001577526. The record lists no products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits for it. California is listed as a jurisdiction of legal exposure with a count of 281.

The website content associated with the company is for Air Liquide, and the listed website is airliquide.com. That material describes Air Liquide as a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare, serving 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees. It also announces a research chair, "Artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry," created by Air Liquide, the Ecole normale superieure and its Foundation.

The material does not describe any AI product or AI position for C3.ai, Inc. itself.
